A quick, forgiving build to get reps in with the saw. Cedar, no joinery to speak of —
just accurate cuts and pilot holes.

## Build steps

```{mermaid}
graph LR
  A[Cut panels] --> B[Drill entrance hole]
  B --> C[Pilot & screw sides]
  C --> D[Attach hinged roof]
  D --> E[Mount & wait for tenants]
```

## Materials

| Part          | Size            | Material |
|---------------|-----------------|----------|
| Front / back  | 150 × 200 mm    | Cedar    |
| Sides         | 150 × 250 mm    | Cedar    |
| Base          | 130 × 130 mm    | Cedar    |
| Roof          | 200 × 200 mm    | Cedar    |

## Result

Done in a weekend. The entrance hole is sized for blue tits (25 mm). Mounted on the
north-east wall, out of the midday sun — now we wait.
